notes.title: New Websites and a New Game!
notes.notes:
Hi! Hope you're doing good. We've been silent for quite some time, but that's because we're working hard on our next project.

[h1]New Websites[/h1]
Not too long ago we updated [url=https://anananasstudio.se/]our main website[/url], as well as [url=https://dundunvr.se/]dundunvr.se[/url]. Check them out and let us know if you have any feedback.[b] Don't forget to sign up for our mailing list[/b] to keep updated and to receive recommendations for 6 surreal paid and free VR experiences. You can do that here: https://anananasstudio.se/?signUp

[h1]New Project[/h1]
Since releasing DunDun VR we've been working on a new VR title within the horror genre. At the moment we haven't announced anything, but if you join our mailing list you'll be the first to know when we eventually do. We're excited to share what we've been up to, and hopefully we can do that soon.

[h1]Thanks for Playing DunDun VR![/h1]
We truly didn't expect such a positive response and as I'm typing we're at 9,709 lifetime unique users. That is insane! ːsteamhappyː We've received almost exclusively positive feedback, which is great. We truly appreciate it.

Have a nice day!
If you want to get in touch with us, the quickest way is to [url=https://discord.gg/sd5pkXEsvt]Join our Discord[/url]

See you there!

notes.title: DunDun VR Patch v1.3 is live! - Oct. 29 2021
notes.notes:
Hello!
It's time for patch v1.3! 

The Fishhead statue in the Goab Desert has been blessed with a voice of his own. Hear him throat sing his heart out as you pass him gracefully in your pod.

[u]Some other noticeable fixes/tweaks/updates:[/u]
[list]
[*] Objects can now take a joyride on the robot vacuum.
[*] Eyes that enter the magic well on their own will not be counted as a legitimate sacrifice.
[*] Minor audio tweaks.
[*] Minor collider tweaks in the Fishmouth Lab.
[*] Fixed issue with objects getting stuck in front of the player when released.
[*] Additional egg spawn points in the Goab Desert!
[/list]
If you discover any bugs, please let us know in here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1695870/discussions/1/ and we'll try to fix them ASAP.

If you want to get in touch, come hang out in our Discord server: https://discord.gg/sd5pkXEsvt

Thanks!
- anananas team

notes.title: DunDun VR Patch v1.2 is live! - Oct. 12 2021
notes.notes:
HejHej!

This time we bring you v.1.2.

[b]We have added support for Windows Mixed Reality![/b] Let us know in the support forum linked below, should you encounter any bugs. We don't have direct access to a WMR HMD, but with the help of our community member [i]I_Buy_Baka-Tari 1998 Commodore[/i], we been able to test DunDun VR on WMR. Thanks for the help!

[u]Some other noticeable fixes/tweaks/updates:[/u]
[list]
[*] Eggs collected in the world are now made anonymous, the type is revealed in the menu.
[*] Collected eggs are now connected to the Steam User ID.
[*] Minor audio tweaks.
[*] Fixed DunDun VR not getting focused on start-up (no need to click on the app window anymore).
[*] Now forcing OpenXR runtime instead of system default.
[/list]
By the way, many seem to miss that there is an in-game menu as well as a grab-ray, so we made this image to show the control scheme for DunDun VR.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40923692/f6afa6665bc93ee805660c925b7894abb6904f0f.png[/img]
The control scheme is also available here: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2622690669
If you discover any bugs, please let us know in here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1695870/discussions/1/ and we'll try to fix them ASAP.

If you want to get in touch, come hang out in our Discord server: https://discord.gg/sd5pkXEsvt

Thanks!
- anananas team

notes.title: DunDun VR Patch v1.1 is live! - Oct. 6 2021
notes.notes:
Hey good people!

Our first patch for DunDun VR is live now. 

First of all, we want to thank everyone who has played DunDun VR, and a special thanks to those of you who left a review! It means a lot and really helps us out. We have had so much fun watching gameplay videos on YouTube and we're super happy that people seem to enjoy it!

[b]The big thing in v1.1 is in-game leaderboards![/b] This is a really cool feature that will display the Steam leaderboard data on the TV screens in the "Fishmouth Lab". If you want to be up there, then you know what to do...which is, to collect those eggs!

[u]Some other noticeable fixes/tweaks/updates:[/u]
[list]
[*] The grab ray is now mapped to the trigger (besides the "X" and "B" buttons).
[*] The black hole is much bigger!
[*] Sound effects are softer and more balanced.
[*] Update on the Legendary Egg texture!
[*] Throwing eyeballs feels better than ever!
[*] A mysterious Feeshman statue has appeared in the Goab desert!
[*] Minor bug fixes and tweaks.
[*] Overall improvements.
[/list]
If you discover any bugs, please let us know in here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1695870/discussions/1/ and we'll try to fix it ASAP.

If you want to get in touch, come hang out in our Discord server: https://discord.gg/sd5pkXEsvt  

Thanks!
- anananas team

notes.title: DunDun VR is out now!
notes.notes:
DunDun VR is a short, surreal, humorous seated or standing experience in VR. It’s a linear single-player first-person adventure with a serene and atmospheric soundtrack. By the way, don’t forget to collect the eggs!

[u]FEATURES[/u]
[list]
[*] A short & surreal experience in VR
[*] Part on-rails and part free roam (teleport or free movement)
[*] An original soundtrack
[*] Interact with odd objects, big bold buttons, and classified keys
[*] Collect eggs
[*] Playtime: 20-30 minutes
[/list]
Thank you so much for checking out DunDun VR. We really hope you enjoy it!
- the anananas team
